name: FIDO
author: rrowles2000 (from K2-D2 by Christophe Floutier, K2D2Redux by IanMealworm)
description: FIDO (Flight Dynamics Operator) is a mission autopilot for KSP2 Redux: ascent, maneuver node execution, transfers, landing, docking, constellations and mission plans, all from one panel (Alt-O or AppBar). Based on K2-D2 by Christophe Floutier and its Redux port K2D2Redux by IanMealworm (CC BY-SA 4.0).
